 assert all(abs(v1-v2)<.001 for v1,v2 in zip([v.x,v.y,v.z],p)),label

 expected_rot=unreal.Rotator(pitch,0,0)

_bench_exit_handle=unreal.register_ticker_callback(_bench_exit,delay=5)
print(json.dumps({'state':'EXIT_SCHEDULED','pid':os.getpid()}))
